Looking at this qlang documentation and the tasks, I'll work through each query carefully, using the first page of the documentation as my only reference.

Let me trace through the key patterns:
- `|` chains steps, `*` runs a step on each element, `!|` handles failures
- `filter ~(...)` takes a condition, `map ~(...)` transforms each element
- `/field` accesses object fields, `/n` accesses array indices
- Literals like `[...]` and `{:key value}` construct values
- Verbs are accessed through the kind of their subject

Working through each task:

T1: Count users with active=true, non-null email ending with "@example.com" (case-insensitive)
T2: Array of names (sorted by lowercase) of users with "admin" role (case-insensitive)
T3: Count users per country; "unknown" for missing/null country
T4: Average age (only non-null), rounded to 2 decimals
T5: From open issues, collect label names, lowercase, deduplicate, sort
T6: Top 3 issues by comments desc, then number asc; return number and assignee
T7: Count open issues per assignee (exclude null assignees)
T8: Merge dependencies, filter for "^" prefix, return as "name@version" sorted
T9: Services with enabled=true AND port > 8000; lowercase names, sorted, comma-joined
T10: Count ERROR lines per service (3rd token)
T11: Average of ms=<int> values from lines, rounded to 1 decimal
T12: Revenue (qty*price) for "shipped" status (case-insensitive), skip empty price
T13: Top 2 customers by total spend (qty*price), excluding "cancelled" and empty price
T14: Lowercase, deduplicate, sort by length desc then alphabetically, join with "-"

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (/email | ne null) (/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count

T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | map ~(/name) | sort ~(lower)

T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at /profile/country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)

T4: /data/users | map ~(at /profile/age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2

T5: filter ~(eq /state "open") | map ~(/labels) | flat | map ~(/name | lower) | distinct | sort

T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at /assignee | at /login)})

T7: filter ~(eq /state "open") | map ~(at /assignee | at /login) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(.) | map ~(count)

T8: /dependencies | union /devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | entries | map ~([/key "@" /value] | join "") | sort

T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at /enabled | coalesce false) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","

T10: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(at 1 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(at 2) | groupBy ~(.) | map ~(count)

T11: lines | map ~(split " ") | flat | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | map ~(drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1

T12: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (at 5 | lower | eq "shipped") (at 4 | ne "")) | map ~(mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2

T13: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (at 5 | lower | ne "cancelled") (at 4 | ne "")) | map ~({:customer /1 :qty (/3 | parseJson) :price (/4 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/customer) | entries | map ~({:customer /key :total (/value | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum | round 2)}) | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2

T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
